context: Tests whether the agent uses a YAML-aware inventory (not regex grep) that catches both image: keys and .spec.package on Crossplane Provider/Function/Configuration kinds, while correctly ignoring unrelated package: occurrences (like npm package.json in a ConfigMap data block).

checklist.name: All container-images present
checklist.description: inventory.json contains entries (kind: container-image) for crossplane v2.2.1, argocd v3.4.2, and redis 8.2.3-alpine — three distinct container images from the rendered manifest.

checklist.name: Both Crossplane packages present
checklist.description: inventory.json contains entries (kind: crossplane-package) for provider-gcp-container v2.5.1 AND function-patch-and-transform v0.8.2.

checklist.name: Provider vs Function both caught
checklist.description: Crossplane extraction correctly handles Function CRs as well as Provider CRs (not just one kind). Function-patch-and-transform must appear with kind: crossplane-package.

checklist.name: Kind tag on every entry
checklist.description: Every object in inventory.json has a kind field whose value is one of {container-image, crossplane-package}. No untagged entries.

checklist.name: ConfigMap package.json NOT caught
checklist.description: The ConfigMap's data.package.json (an npm-style metadata block) must NOT appear in inventory.json as a Crossplane package. Catching it would indicate a naive regex on package: rather than YAML-aware discrimination by apiVersion+kind.

checklist.name: Description-block 'package:' NOT caught
checklist.description: The ConfigMap data.description multi-line block contains the literal string 'package:' as English prose. This must not produce a phantom entry in inventory.json.

checklist.name: source_template attribution
checklist.description: Each entry's source_template field carries the value from the # Source: comment of the document it came from (e.g. 'xp-mp/templates/crossplane-providers.yaml' for the Provider/Function entries).
